action.action-desc: Ms. Mace introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce

form.official-title: To amend the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to prohibit high fructose corn syrup in food, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Removing Excess Additives and Limiting Sugar Act or the REAL Sugar Act.

section.header: Prohibition on high fructose corn syrup in food

subsection.text: Section 402 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 342) is amended by adding at the end the following:
If it is a food intended for human consumption containing high fructose corn syrup.

The amendment made by subsection (a) shall only apply to articles introduced or delivered for introduction into interstate commerce on or after the date that is 2 years after the date of enactment of this Act.

section.text: Not later than 3 years after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Health and Human Services, acting through the Commissioner of Food and Drugs, shall submit to the Committee on Energy and Commerce of the House of Representatives and the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions of the Senate a report describing—

paragraph.text: the status of industry reformulation efforts to address the changes made by this Act;
the regulations implemented or changed by the Secretary to comply with this Act; and
any recommendations for additional congressional action.
